sections.description:
Uncoder Elements is a powerful Elementor addon that brings useful widgets, design controls, performance tools, and WooCommerce-ready enhancements into one lightweight plugin.

It includes 10+ creative widgets, mega menu support, custom animations, advanced Elementor controls, 7000+ SVG optimized icons, WebP generation, database optimization, loading speed improvements, and more.

Whether you are building landing pages, business websites, WooCommerce stores, blogs, or custom Elementor layouts, Uncoder Elements helps you design faster, customize better, and keep your website optimized.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Uncoder Elements plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin.
  5. Select the uncoder-elements.zip file and click Install Now.
  6. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
  7. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated to use the Elementor widgets and controls.
